details:
Due to human nature, repeat players may not likely go to view new worlds and often go to worlds such as "the box" 24/7

There are players who work night and day for months at a time to make their world but then become buried below the world lists
There is no reason why the box should be on 2 rows immediately ontop of the world list
This is just begging users to go to these worlds and never visit fresh content to vrchat
This stunts creation growth where people work day-in and day-out just for people to not to go

It is VRchats part to give creators a place to show their worlds and creativity. if it is going to be buried at the very bottom of the menu, then vrchat is not promoting these new or hard working creators.

Counter arguments could be: Why should vrchat do this? If a creators world has no visitors, then is it not their fault? Then wouldn't low quality worlds just be flooding the world list? 

1. Vrchat's needs to give players a reason to comeback, too many players are leaving because their experience becomes "VRMirror" or "VRlagfreebox". Longtime players often complain how the game just becomes inactivity sessions.  
2. It's not a creators's fault, its human nature's fault for not wanting to go to the very bottom of a list for new and fresh. It would rather prefer something familiar and in a loop, it is very hard for a new world to make it to a the top of the world list beating out the pug and box for 1st place. Not every one can make a Volt or hangout house. The Volt took a year to reach public world ready and the Hangout house had to use a new format for video players. There are many creators who worked as hard and invested so much of their time but are not able to break the mold without vrchat pushing
3. VRChat filters out "low quality" worlds during their stricter approval process, its been harder for these low effort worlds to even be considered

There's not a lack of creativity for vrchat but "bad placement" influencing keeping players from going to visit new and fresh worlds and it could be greatly influential to keeping activity rather than the old "bottom of the list" style
title: Reorder the worlds tabs to bring more people to new worlds
